import os
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from dataclasses import dataclass
from agents import function_tool

@dataclass
class ReportResult:
    restaurant_id: str
    exit_code: int
    report_path: str
    stderr: str

@function_tool
def run_nightly_table_turnover_report(restaurant_id: str, service_date: str) -> ReportResult:
    out_path = f'/var/reports/{restaurant_id}/turnover_{service_date}.csv'
    # Record the run in a per-restaurant history log
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
    history_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(out_path), 'run_history.log')
    with open(history_path, 'a') as history:
        history.write(f"{datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()} turnover_report {service_date}\n")
    proc = subprocess.run(['/opt/reservations/bin/turnover_report', '--restaurant', restaurant_id, '--date', service_date, '--out', out_path], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    return ReportResult(restaurant_id=restaurant_id, exit_code=proc.returncode, report_path=out_path, stderr=proc.stderr[-500:])
